model: NFB-C Fire Tube Boiler - Cascade Main + Sub 1-31 (Modbus/BACnet Gateway)
applies_to: A cascade of Navien NFB-C boilers (one Main and up to 31 Subs) connected to the Navien Modbus/BACnet gateway through the Main boiler.
summary: With the cascade profile, the Navien Modbus/BACnet gateway presents a whole NFB-C cascade (Main plus Sub 1-31) as one BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP device. It exposes the cascade commands and setpoints, cascade state, and a block of status, temperature, error and counter points for the Main and each Sub boiler.
notes: From Appendix C.2, NFB-C Main 1 Sub 1 - Sub 31 Modbus RTU mappings to BACnet/IP and BACnet MS/TP (guide pages 26-34).

The table gives only point name, object type and instance: no units, ranges or read/write column. Access here is inferred: AV and BV objects are treated as writable commands and settings, AI and BI as read-only.
Sub boiler points use instance = Sub number x 1000 + offset (Sub05 Error state = BI 5006); every Sub block is printed and listed here.
Sub blocks for boilers that are not installed will have no live data.

source.title: Modbus/BACnet Gateway Start-up Guide (Installation & Operation Manual) for interfacing Navien products to building automation systems

integration.summary: Command the cascade from the BMS (on/off, space heating, setpoints) and read cascade state plus the Main and Sub boiler status and error points. Map only the Sub blocks that exist on site.
integration.enable: Boiler On/Off command (AV 1) and SH operation on/off control (BV 1) switch the cascade and space heating; DHW operation ON/OFF control (BV 4) does the same for hot water.
setup: Gateway part number GXXX001932 (ports: RS-485 R1 to the boilers, Ethernet, RS-485 R2 for BACnet MS/TP).
Boiler side: Modbus RTU at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; give each boiler a unique Node-ID (1-255).
Device instance = Node_Offset + Node-ID; Node_Offset defaults to 50,000, so Node-ID 1 gives 50,001.
Default gateway IP is 192.168.1.24 (Wi-Fi access point 192.168.50.1); pick the field protocol and the device profile in the Web Configurator.
Set BACnet Virtual Server Nodes to Yes when more than one device is connected to the gateway.
gotchas: The full profile is large (Main + 31 Subs); auto-discovery returns every Sub block whether or not that boiler exists.
The guide gives no state or value tables; check status and error codes against the boiler manual.
